headline: Does he want to commit, or does he just want company?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, but your hand found the one who chooses what to place in view.
His table is carefully arranged, with every object visible.
You asked whether he wants commitment or only company. What catches me is how deliberately the table is presented.
He is present, and the purpose of the relationship remains uncertain to you.
I keep coming back to something between his presence and a named commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Now let me look at what's doing this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the calmest figure here.
He hangs by one ankle. His face is calm.
You asked what future he wants. This card makes me look at the calm presence inside the pause.
Still, he is there while the commitment question stays held.
Something is holding the future quietly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the future…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the card, yet your hand went to the one who hadn't packed for everything.
One small bundle is all he carries at the start.
You asked whether he wants a future or the comfort of now. The light bundle holds my attention.
But the connection exists now, and the future remains lightly carried.
Something appears right where company would need to become commitment. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
